description: This PHP class defines filter parameters for searching qualification education data within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifies default sorting behavior and allowed sort fields.

classes.name: QualificationEducationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used to specify filtering parameters for education qualification searches within the OrangeHRM application. It restricts sorting to specific fields and sets a default sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field 'e.name'.
